verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents official Desktop and Mobile apps alongside the web workspace. The desktop app ships capabilities beyond chat, such as installing local MCP connectors and a terminal with session tabs. The mobile app is described only by a tagline, and no source documents feature parity across surfaces. Missing for 10: documented mobile feature set beyond a tagline, explicit cross-surface feature parity, and independent hands-on corroboration of the apps.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant also meets me in official web, desktop, or mobile apps with feature parity beyond the chat basics

citations.quote: LobeHub Desktop — Powerful features. Runs locally. Privacy-first.
LobeHub Mobile — Your Agent Team on the go
Desktop can now install and run MCP connectors that live on your machine or your local network.
The desktop terminal now has clearer tabs, right-click actions to close one or all other sessions, smoother open and close transitions, and faster rendering for active terminals.
